findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_service" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read one IQ.net catalogue record by the slug from search_services. Returns endpoints, advertised prices, documentation, and GitHub project metadata when a repos…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, search_services · Private data: get_service · Public sink: get_service, search_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, search_services · Private data: get_service · Public sink: get_service, search_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
